title: History ancestry and choices
responsibility: Finds recorded ancestors and builds branch and revision choices.

inputs.name: branchNames.index
inputs.description: Index whose usable branch names are requested.

inputs.name: defaultCommit.asked
inputs.description: Requested commit, honored only if stored.

inputs.name: branchCommits.index
inputs.description: Index whose revision order is retained.

inputs.name: branchCommits.branch
inputs.description: Branch name or the Retained commits pseudo-branch.

inputs.name: branchOf.index
inputs.description: Index used to choose a branch for a commit.

outputs.name: harnessAncestry
outputs.description: Set reached through recorded parent links, normally excluding the starting commit; includes named parents even when their own details are not indexed.

outputs.name: branchNames
outputs.description: Source branches with indexed members, plus Retained commits when any retained revision exists.

outputs.name: defaultCommit
outputs.description: Requested stored commit, else first stored branch head, else first indexed revision, else an empty string.

outputs.name: branchCommits
outputs.description: Revisions belonging to the branch, or retained revisions, in index order.

outputs.name: branchOf
outputs.description: Retained commits for a retained revision, otherwise its first branch, first offered branch, or an empty string.

outputs.name: revisionLabel
outputs.description: Short commit, subject and readable coverage status.
